label: Some universal cause of esse leaves an actual perfection of its effect to a secondary cause
paraphrase: Rival framework commitment, unattributed (motivated by mere conservationism): for some c, x, r and d, c causes the esse of every other thing in act in esse; x is other than c and c causes x's esse; x is in act in r; c does not cause x's being r; and d, other than c, causes x's being r. It is neither occasionalism nor concurrentism.
